remarks: With NYC at your fingertips from Southport train station, less than a mile away from this flat is where you'll want to be and where the fun won't end! Offering hardwood floors through out, lots of storage space, washer/dryer in unit and lots of privacy, yet in close proximity to shops, restaurants, beaches and easy access to I95. This flat has an alley style kitchen with granite countertops, overlooking onto its quaint dining area and cozy living room with vaulted ceilings. Bedrooms has two closets, vaulted ceilings and full bathroom. Right across the street is the store with all furnishings you didn't know you want to make this flat yours!
